answer: Quadratic attestation pricing makes endorsement explode for a ring of fake identities in a tundra market. A new identity needs three attestations, each recorded in a sable atlas of who endorsed whom. Each attestation locks a bond; the k-th attestation from one attester costs k squared credits: 1, 100, 10,000 at k = 1, 10, 100. Fresh attesters cannot dodge this: each must first earn three attestations itself. Attestation-ring farming loses its bonds when falcon auditors expose it; 100 fakes cost 338,350 credits, while an honest agent pays 1 credit once and keeps standing.
